experimental_design.evidence: inferred: The aim of the study was to analyze serial CSF samples collected at different stages of treatment, as well as a control sample, to identify differences in CSF protein expression profiles during CNS RB relapse.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: Over-regulated proteins in CSF-RB samples were primarily involved in inflammation, extracellular matrix remodeling, epithelial mesenchymal transition initiation, migration, invasion, and cellular metabolism (PON1, RNPEP, MCAM, NEGR1, NID1, SERPINA1, FAT2, RELN, NEGR1, and SEZ6).
